typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	DX_PASSWORD as string (),
	DX_SERVER as string (),
	DX_USER_ID as string (),
	InitialCatalog as string (),
	RptDate as timestamp (),
	varArchivePath as string (),
	varDestinationPath as string (),
	varFileFullPath as string (),
	varFileName as string (),
	varFileNameCollection as string (),
	varGRGR_CK as string ()
}

source(output(
		Patient_ID as string,
		Zip as string,
		Group as string,
		Middle_Name as string,
		RiskMethodology1 as string,
		RiskMethodology2 as string,
		Care_Manager_Phone as string,
		NPI as string,
		Practice as string,
		Gender as string,
		Care_Alert as string,
		Care_Manager_Email as string,
		First_Name as string,
		Member_Status as string,
		Care_Program_EndDt as string,
		Address_1 as string,
		Care_Manager as string,
		Address_2 as string,
		Work_Phone as string,
		Assigning_Authority_Code as string,
		Cell_Phone as string,
		Account_Number as string,
		ENS_Startdate as string,
		{Follow Up Date} as string,
		Care_Program as string,
		Name_Suffix as string,
		City as string,
		TaxID as string,
		Birthdate as string,
		RiskScore2 as string,
		ACO as string,
		RiskScore1 as string,
		Care_Program_StartDt as string,
		SSN as string,
		Home_Phone as string,
		DocHaloID as string,
		{Appointment Missed Date} as string,
		Last_Name as string,
		State as string,
		Insurance as string,
		Region as string,
		DirectEmail as string,
		PCP as string,
		Location as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'DECLARE @DAY as Numeric (10), @MONTH_RUN as Numeric (10) SET @DAY = DATEPART (DD,GETDATE ()) SET @MONTH_RUN = 15   SELECT  \'\' AS [Group] ,(CASE WHEN @DAY = @MONTH_RUN AND CM.MemberStatus = \'ACTIVE\' THEN \'ADD\' ELSE CM.[MemberStatus]  END) AS [Member_Status] ,CM.[PATIENT_ID] AS [Patient_ID] ,CM.[FirstName] AS [First_Name] ,CM.[MiddleInitialName] AS [Middle_Name] ,CM.[LastName] AS [Last_Name] ,\'\' AS [Name_Suffix] ,CM.[ADDR1] AS [Address_1] ,CM.[ADDR2] AS [Address_2] ,CM.[City] AS [City] ,CM.[State] AS [State] ,CM.[zip] AS [Zip] ,CM.[DOB] AS [Birthdate] ,CM.[Sex] AS [Gender] ,CM.[SSN] AS [SSN] ,CM.[HOME_PHONE] AS [Home_Phone] ,CM.[Work_Phone] AS [Work_Phone] ,CM.[Cell_Phone] AS [Cell_Phone] ,\'\' AS [Practice] ,(CASE WHEN CM.PCP_STREET_ADDRESS IN (\'\',\'.\',\'X\')  OR CM.PCP_STREET_ADDRESS IS NULL Then \'Not Available\'  ELSE CM.PCP_STREET_ADDRESS END) AS [Location] ,(CASE WHEN CM.PCP_PROV_NAME IN (\'\',\'.\',\'X\',\'Not_Available\')  OR CM.PCP_PROV_NAME IS NULL Then \'Not Available\'  ELSE CM.PCP_PROV_NAME END) AS [PCP] ,(CASE WHEN CM.PCP_NPI_Nbr IN (\'\',\'.\',\'X\')  OR CM.PCP_NPI_Nbr IS NULL Then \'Not Available\'  ELSE CM.PCP_NPI_Nbr END) AS [NPI] ,COALESCE(CAST(REPLACE(CM.PCP_TAX_ID, \'_\', \' \') AS VARCHAR(25)),\'Not Available\') AS [TaxID] ,\'\' AS [Insurance] ,\'\' AS [ACO] ,\'\' AS [Account_Number] ,\'\' AS [ENS_Startdate] ,(CASE WHEN CM.CAREPROGRAM IN (\'\',\'.\',\'X\')  OR CM.CAREPROGRAM IS NULL Then \'Not Available\'  ELSE CM.CAREPROGRAM END) AS [Care_Program] ,REPLACE(CONVERT(VARCHAR(20), CM.CAREPROGRAM_Start_DT, 110),\'-\', \'/\') AS [Care_Program_StartDt] ,REPLACE(CONVERT(VARCHAR(20), CM.CAREPROGRAM_END_DT, 110),\'-\', \'/\') AS [Care_Program_EndDt] ,(CASE WHEN CM.CAREPROGRAM_MGR_NAME IN (\'\',\'.\',\'X\')  OR CM.CAREPROGRAM_MGR_NAME IS NULL Then \'Not Available\'  ELSE CM.CAREPROGRAM_MGR_NAME END) AS [Care_Manager] ,(CASE When CM.CAREPROGRAM_MGR_PHONE_NBR = \'X\' THEN \'Not Available\' 	ELSE   CM.CAREPROGRAM_MGR_PHONE_NBR END) AS [Care_Manager_Phone] ,(CASE When CM.CAREPROGRAM_EMAIL_ADDRESS = \'X\' THEN \'Not Available\' 	ELSE   CM.CAREPROGRAM_EMAIL_ADDRESS END) AS [Care_Manager_Email] ,\'\' AS [RiskScore1] ,\'\' AS [RiskMethodology1] ,\'\' AS [RiskScore2] ,\'\' AS [RiskMethodology2] ,\'\' AS [Region] ,\'\' AS [DirectEmail] ,\'\' AS [DocHaloID] ,\'\' AS [Follow Up Date] ,\'\' AS [Appointment Missed Date] ,\'\' AS [Care_Alert] ,\'\' AS [Assigning_Authority_Code] FROM	[DATA_EXCHANGE].[Crisp].[CrispMembers] CM INNER JOIN	##Final_RR_Members RR ON		CM.MemberID = LTRIM(RTRIM(RR.[Member ID])) WHERE	RR.GRGR_CK = 6 AND		( 		             ( @DAY != @MONTH_RUN		AND MemberStatus != \'ACTIVE\' ) OR	           ( @DAY = @MONTH_RUN		AND 1=1 )									)',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> OLEDBSource

		Member_Status,
		Care_Program_EndDt,
		Address_1,
		Care_Manager,
		Address_2,
		Work_Phone,
		Assigning_Authority_Code,
		Cell_Phone,
		Account_Number,
		ENS_Startdate,
		Follow_Up_Date = {Follow Up Date},
		Care_Program,
		Name_Suffix,
		City,
		TaxID,
		Birthdate,
		RiskScore2,
		ACO,
		RiskScore1,
		Care_Program_StartDt,
		SSN,
		Home_Phone,
		DocHaloID,
		Appointment_Missed_Date = {Appointment Missed Date},
		Last_Name,
		State,
		Insurance,
		Region,
		DirectEmail,
		PCP,
		Location)) ~> FlatFileDestination
